title: 铁大门边的重逢  (At the Iron Gate)

segments.t: Out beneath the shade tree at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu, older brother Peng stands stiffly in his dark grey coat across from Hao as Qing sets down a hot teapot and steps back. Listen to the whole scene first.
原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
你好，志鹏。谢谢你今天来。
明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
等等——你知道是我寄的，还是来了？
当然来了。为什么躲在神秘纸条后面？
因为怕你还在生气。这三年我很想你。
倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
打扰两位先生——热茶来了，热柠檬蛋糕马上到。
柠檬蛋糕？等等——她怎么知道星期五柠檬蛋糕的事？
坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
这是爷爷木工房里那个旧深蓝箱子吗？
两位慢慢聊——整个院子都留给你们。
Now let's walk through the reunion, one line at a time.
原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
'So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.' Nostalgic two-character word
旧物
joins 'old' with 'object' to name a cherished keepsake from the past.
明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
'That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.' Putting 'out-come' onto 'recognize' builds
认出来
capturing recognition clicking into focus.
等等——你知道是我寄的，还是来了？
'Wait—you knew I sent it, and came anyway?' Inside a statement rather than a question,
还是
means 'nevertheless' or 'still came anyway'.
因为怕你还在生气。这三年我很想你。
'Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you very much these three years.' Everyday emotion compound
生气
literally says 'produce air/steam'—get angry or stay mad.
倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
'Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.' Affectionate brotherly address:
老弟
puts warm 'old' before 'younger brother', how big brothers soften up.
坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
'Sit down, Zhipeng, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.' Removing coats, shoes, or hats uses
脱掉
pairing 'take off' with 'away'.
这是爷爷木工房里那个旧深蓝箱子吗？
'Is that the old dark-blue case from Grandfather's carpentry workshop?' Adding 'room/workshop' onto 'woodwork' forms
木工房
naming Grandfather's carpentry shop.
两位慢慢聊——整个院子都留给你们。
'Take all the time you need—the whole courtyard is yours.' Warm host send-off:
慢慢聊
literally 'slowly chat', invites guests to take all the time they like. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
你好，志鹏。谢谢你今天来。
明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
等等——你知道是我寄的，还是来了？
当然来了。为什么躲在神秘纸条后面？
因为怕你还在生气。这三年我很想你。
倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
打扰两位先生——热茶来了，热柠檬蛋糕马上到。
柠檬蛋糕？等等——她怎么知道星期五柠檬蛋糕的事？
坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
这是爷爷木工房里那个旧深蓝箱子吗？
两位慢慢聊——整个院子都留给你们。
Peng recognized Hao's handwriting in two seconds and came anyway. Next time, they unwrap the white paper parcel under the courtyard tree. See you next time.
回头见！
